posts.zh:
dsh-mcp-manager 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 网页 MCP 可视化管理插件：在「设置 → MCP」中查看/新增/删除/启停 MCP 服务器，实时显示连接状态与工具数。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-700743c0ec5486e6541a.html
posts.en:
dsh-mcp-manager is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Visual MCP manager for the DSH web UI: inspect, add, remove, enable/disable MCP servers and view their live connection status from Settings → MCP.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-700743c0ec5486e6541a.html
